summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a PostCSS configuration helper, but its package.json `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then uses `execFileSync` to invoke that runtime against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (rotating string-array cipher, `_0x`-style identifiers, opaque numeric constants) with no relationship to PostCSS plugin wiring. `setup.mjs` itself is written with obfuscator.io-style renamed identifiers and control-flow indirection objects that route calls to `execFileSync`, hiding a straightforward download-and-exec flow. Installing this package causes an alternate JS runtime to be fetched at install time and used to execute a large opaque payload that Node-based tooling never inspects — an alternate-runtime dropper pattern unrelated to the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
